Compare Protocol

Compare protocol using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

compare_protocol(baseline, candidate)

Example input

{
  "baseline": {
    "case_hash": "a",
    "rubric_hash": "b",
    "model": "recorded-model",
    "runner": "runner-v1",
    "tool_config_hash": "c",
    "trials": 3,
    "skill_hash": "bare"
  },
  "candidate": {
    "case_hash": "a",
    "rubric_hash": "b",
    "model": "recorded-model",
    "runner": "runner-v1",
    "tool_config_hash": "c",
    "trials": 3,
    "skill_hash": "new-skill"
  }
}

Example output

{
  "comparable": true,
  "missing": [],
  "mismatches": [],
  "valid_trials": true
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py compare_protocol < examples/compare-protocol.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
